decision.reason: All 112 complete calls pass independent energy/triples/force/residual gates; native analytic oracle, disabled/fallback/exact-budget gates, public tests and memcheck pass. Paired speed observations with uncertainty and work counts are retained separately.

reproduction.instructions: Decode source.patch.gz byte-for-byte before applying the unchanged patch. Apply source.patch to the parent revision. Configure Release CUDA 12.9 sm_120 with explicit CXX/CUDA ccache launchers, checkout-root CCACHE_BASEDIR and fast_compile=false. Build generativeqc_cc_lambda_preconditioner_tests. Use finite Slurm main allocations (gpu:5090:1 on n5; gpu:pro6000:1 on n2), preserve CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Set GENERATIVEQC_LIBRARY, PYTHONPATH=python:., CPU library threads=1 and a new GENERATIVEQC_DF_PROGRESS_TRACE path. Use NumPy, SciPy, PySCF 2.14 and threadpoolctl; ensure the Python runtime preloads CUDA 12.9 libraries matching the linked library (runtime-libraries manifest in summary). Alternate parent/candidate processes in six AB/BA pairs for --atoms 6 and 12; retain cold, warm, warm-repeat and changed calls. Run native test with and without --cuda plus test_rccsdt_public.py/test_rccsd_public.py with CUDA opt-in environment variables. Memcheck native probe and all four complete 14-AO calls. Profile four 28-AO calls with Nsight CUDA tracing to verify launches and copies.
